summary: Tested the Comandă de Lucru refactor (inline line edit, LINE_LOCKED, quote-approval status rules, paper approval of quotes) on both backend and UI, using isolated TEST data only. Backend: 101/105 tests passed and 1 was skipped, across test_line_inline_edit, test_paper_quote_approval, test_status_quote_guard, test_closure_review and test_fiscal_quote_gate. The only failures: sending an explicit JSON null in PUT /lines returns 500. UI on desktop (1920) and mobile (390): every requested item works.

minor.issue: Sending explicit null (e.g. {"qty": null}, {"description": null}, {"unit_price": null}, {"discount": null}) returns 500. Cause: body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) keeps None values, so validate_line_update does None <= 0 (TypeError) and None.strip() (AttributeError). No data is corrupted because the crash happens before $set. Fix: use model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude_none=True), or return 400 for None.

issues: The decision line ('Decizie: name · via · at') does not show whether the approval was a paper approval or a digital signature. Suggestion: add a badge such as 'Aprobat pe hârtie' when decision.paper_approved is set.

action_items: routes_service.update_line: ignore or reject None fields (model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude_none=True)) so explicit nulls do not return 500
critical_code_review_comments: QuotesTab.decide: run() catches errors and then .then(() => setApprove(null)) always runs, so the approval dialog closes even when the API fails. The user loses the signature they drew. Keep the dialog open on error.

WorkOrderDetail status selector offers 'finalizata' once a quote is approved even when QC has not passed. The backend correctly rejects it with a toast. Optionally also hide or disable the option while qc.passed is false.
Verified: the PUT ignores fields outside LineUpdateIn (source_warehouse, type, vat_rate, product_id), so the part source stays read-only on the server side as well.
verified_ok: PUT line updates description/code/qty/unit_price/discount/mechanic_id and recalculates totals. Example: part 3x200 with 10% discount = 540, net 690, VAT 144.9, gross 834.9; values persist on GET.

Validation returns 400 for qty<=0, price<0, discount outside 0..100 and blank description. A non-existent or invalid mechanic returns 404/400. A missing line returns 404. Boundary values price=0 and discount=100 are accepted.
Line PUT/POST/DELETE return 400 for finalizata, facturata and inchisa, and for is_warranty work orders. All other statuses allow edits.
Status: aprobata/finalizata return 400 with no approved quote, including draft/sent/rejected/superseded/mixed quotes. finalizata without QC returns 400; with QC passed it returns 200.

Internal paper approval (no signature) sets the quote to approved and the work order to aprobata, with decision.paper_approved=true and via=service. The public route returns 403 when paper_approved is true (with or without a signature). Public approval with a signature still works.
UI: DiagnosisPanel and AllocationPanel are separate. AllocationPanel comes after the tabs and is the last section. wo-closure-category-select is absent.

UI: parts and labor edit/save/cancel works per row, with all required input testids. The part source (part-source-row) is read-only. Cancel discards the draft. An invalid qty shows an error toast and the row stays in edit mode.
UI totals after inline edits: part 3x150 with 10% = 405, labor 2x200 = 400, net 805, VAT 169.05, total 974.05.
UI: on a finalizata work order there are no edit/delete buttons and no add forms.
UI: with no approved quote, the status select has no aprobata/finalizata options. After paper approval, finalizata appears; applying it without QC shows the backend error toast.

Quote modal: confirm is disabled until the paper checkbox is ticked and becomes disabled again when it is unticked. Paper confirmation works without a signature. The public approval page has no paper option.
Mobile 390px: document scrollWidth is 390 (no outer overflow). The parts and labor tables scroll inside their containers (920/980px inside a 324px wrapper, overflow-x auto).
seed_data_creation: Isolated TEST_ data only, created via inline_edit_ui_fixture.py / paper_ui_fixture.py and the pytest fixtures, all torn down afterwards. Stale TEST-INLINEUI-* and TEST-PUI899FE9-* records left by an earlier run were also removed. The fixtures confirmed that CL-2026-00083/00086/00069 were not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_line_inline_edit.py test_paper_quote_approval.py test_status_quote_guard.py. test_explicit_null_no_500 should pass once update_line drops or rejects None values. UI fixtures: python inline_edit_ui_fixture.py setup|teardown, python paper_ui_fixture.py setup|teardown.
